name: Flame detector plan symbol
summary: Plan symbol for a flame detector that senses ultraviolet or infrared radiation from flames, with its cone of view.
description: Flame detectors sense the radiation emitted by flames, using ultraviolet, infrared or combined sensors. Plans draw the detector with radiation arrows and often the field-of-view cone so coverage can be checked against the protected hazard.

They are used for fuel stores, generator rooms, turbine enclosures and hazardous industrial areas where flaming fires are expected. Hazardous-area classification may also apply to the device, which the plan should tag. The cone drawn is approximate; sensitivity falls with distance and angle. Check the product data.
readingNotes: Check the cone covers the hazard.
distinction: A smoke detector responds to particles; a flame detector responds to radiation from the flame.
